card.name: Verbs after does/do/not in evaluations
card.fires_on: A short verb or adjective right after 'do', 'does not', 'is not' or 'a' that completes an evaluative phrase, such as 'does us the great service', 'you'll do fine', 'not good at'. Weaker hits appear in copyright credits and site names.

modes.label: Verb after does/do/not
modes.description: The word that completes a phrase about benefit, help or fit, such as do, serve, help or good.
modes.example: Follow them and you'll<< do>> fine.

modes.label: Site or credit names
modes.description: A part of a website or credit name in a copyright line.

card.plain: It fires on the word that finishes a phrase about whether something helps or works, like 'does not help' or 'you'll do fine'.
